He will pay 1 mina per month from the month Kanwarta, eponymate Ibni-Adad s. Qarwum.
The remainder of the silver is 1 mina and 2 minas.
I said, "Let your representatives come so that they may come."
My dear father and lord, let your message come from the ḫamuštum of Aššur-mālik.
If you gave the tin to the merchant, then give it to the merchant.
Urgent, Ilī-ālum will dispatch Ilī-ālum.
From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā and Aššur-taklāku:
To Aššur-nādā:
You sent 5 minas silver from your ikribū of Aššur.
The remainder of your kutānum textiles are exhausted.
I gave 1/2 shekels silver to his account.
Let your tin come as to how much tin you sent to you.
Šū-Nunu brings you 2 minas refined silver.
To Aššur-taklāku:
You sent me 5 minas 5 shekels silver from your ikribū of Aššur.
If he does not pay, he will add 1/2 shekels per mina per month as interest.
